ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity (white) surface area vs. 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated at edges and base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) border pixels along the entire trailing edge and tips. A large, vertically-oriented low-intensity patch at the central base (peduncle junction). Sparse low-intensity circular mottling clusters on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe shows high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe displays a significant macro-notch (large indentation) approximately mid-way to the tip, followed by irregular jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curve from median notch to tips, with a distinct concave interruption on the trailing edge of the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters detected on the mid-to-outer region of the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, low-intensity horizontal linear mark (approx. 40 pixels in length) on the right lobe. Several smaller vertical linear marks located near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major V-shaped indentation/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe; prominent horizontal linear scar on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant bilateral asymmetry in trailing edge topography due to the large right-lobe notch.
